material_processing_set.name: Metabolite Extraction from Soil
material_processing_set.description: Soil was bead beat in 60% methanol solution for 15 min at 4Cel. Then, 12 mL of ice-cold chloroform was added. Samples were probe sonicated at 60% amplitude for 30 seconds on ice, cooled, and sonicated again. Samples were incubated for 5 min at -80Cel, vortexed for 1 min, and centrifuged at 4500g for 10 min at 4Cel. The upper aqueous phase was collected into a separate glass vial, dried in a vacuum concentrator.
